claim_boundary: A pass supports transfer of an invariant projective nonlinear mechanism together with a learned low-dimensional connection on its realization coefficients across operating context, using three probes at one RPM condition and zero probes at target RPM conditions, on an independently collected external wind-tunnel dataset. It does not establish novelty over all LPV methods, uniqueness of the representation, exact aerodynamic theory, broad-domain generality, or general AI scientific discovery.

outcome_blind_metadata_already_read: GeneralInfo workbook dimensions and availability flags

source.dataset: ENOLA numerical and experimental propeller database
source.collector: CMT-Clean Mobility & Thermofluid institute, Universitat Politecnica de Valencia
source.independence: separately collected from UIUC development data

target.standard_definitions: J=V/(nD); CT=T/(rho*n^2*D^4) if coefficients are not directly supplied

invariant_mechanism.source: v0.14 pure-J projective mechanism learned only from consumed UIUC development families

calibration_and_contexts.rpm_context_construction: Cluster parsed rows by actual RPM after sorting; a new context starts when the next RPM exceeds the current cluster median by more than 8 percent. Discard clusters with fewer than 5 valid aerodynamic rows or J span below 0.10.
calibration_and_contexts.probe_rule: nearest distinct calibration row to each quantile target without replacement
calibration_and_contexts.common_support: score a target row only if its J lies inside the closed min/max J support of the three calibration probes; require at least 10 scored target rows per propeller

controls.static_plain_J: Fit [a,b,s] on the identical three calibration probes in plain J and reuse theta unchanged at all target RPM contexts.
controls.v014_corrected_coordinate: R=(RPM/5000)*(D_in/10)^2; xi=J*R^(-0.1); h_corr(xi)=0.9373292565084214*xi^2-0.3484449237589354*xi^3. Fit [a,b,s] on the same three calibration rows evaluated at calibration xi and reuse those coefficients at target xi.
controls.fairness: All primary models receive exactly the same three calibration outcome values and no target-context outcome values.

metrics.propeller_nrmse: For each model, concatenate scored target-context CT predictions; RMSE divided by max(observed CT)-min(observed CT), invalid if CT range <0.01.
metrics.paired_ratio: Per-propeller connection NRMSE divided by control NRMSE; summarize median, geometric mean, and win fraction.

invalidity_rules: required aerodynamic columns cannot be parsed under the frozen schema
calibration design matrix is singular or condition number exceeds 1e8
fewer than 10 target rows on common calibration-probe J support
